tooltip: White Balance - selects Auto or Manual white balance control
content1: Selects whether the camera continuously determines white balance automatically or uses a manually specified white balance.
content2:
WhiteBalanceMode indicates the white balance control mode:
  1. AUTO_WB (0x00) - Automatic white balance.
  2. MANUAL_WB (0x01) - Manual white balance.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current white balance mode along with the active auto/manual feature.
getAPICode:
uint8_t outMode, outAutoFeature, outManualFeature;
see3cam_cu200Instance->getWhiteBalanceMode(outMode, outAutoFeature, outManualFeature);
setAPIHeading: bool setWhiteBalanceMode(WhiteBalanceMode mode, AutoWbFeature autoFeature, ManualWbMode manualFeature, WbPreset presetMode)
setAPIDes: Sets the white balance mode, auto-white-balance behaviour, manual white balance sub-mode, and (when applicable) the preset.

tooltip: Auto White Balance - Continuous or One-shot behaviour, and a manual Trigger
content1: When White Balance is Auto, selects whether the camera continuously re-evaluates white balance or evaluates it once when triggered.
content2:
AutoWbFeature:
  1. WB_CONTINIOUS (0x00) - Continuous auto white balance.
  2. WB_SINGLE_SHOT (0x01) - One-shot auto white balance.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current auto white balance behaviour along with the overall mode.
getAPICode:
uint8_t outMode, outAutoFeature, outManualFeature;
see3cam_cu200Instance->getWhiteBalanceMode(outMode, outAutoFeature, outManualFeature);
setAPIHeading: bool setWhiteBalanceMode(WhiteBalanceMode mode, AutoWbFeature autoFeature, ManualWbMode manualFeature, WbPreset presetMode)
setAPIDes: Sets the auto white balance behaviour (Continuous/One-shot) while White Balance mode is Auto.

tooltip: Manual White Balance - Color Temperature, Preset, or Pro Mode RGB gains
content1: When White Balance is Manual, selects how white balance is manually specified: by color temperature, by a named preset, or (Pro Mode) by individual RGB gain sliders.
content2:
ManualWbMode:
  1. WB_COLOR_TEMPERATURE (0x00)
  2. WB_PRESET_MODE (0x01)
  3. WB_PRO_MODE (0x02)
WbPreset selects one of 8 lighting presets from HZ(2300K) to D65(6500K).
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current manual white balance sub-mode.
getAPICode:
uint8_t outMode, outAutoFeature, outManualFeature;
see3cam_cu200Instance->getWhiteBalanceMode(outMode, outAutoFeature, outManualFeature);
setAPIHeading:
bool setWhiteBalanceMode(WhiteBalanceMode mode, AutoWbFeature autoFeature, ManualWbMode manualFeature, WbPreset presetMode)
bool setColorTemperature(uint16_t colorTemp)
bool setRBGain(float rGain, float bGain)
setAPIDes: Sets the manual white balance sub-mode; the color temperature or RGB gain values are then set with the dedicated setColorTemperature/setRBGain calls.

tooltip: Exposure - selects Auto or Manual exposure, and the auto-exposure feature
content1: Selects Auto or Manual exposure control. In Auto mode, additionally selects Continuous or Single-shot auto-exposure. In Manual mode, sets a fixed exposure time.
content2:
ExposureMode: AUTO_EXPOSURE (0x00), MANUAL_EXPOSURE (0x01).
AutoExposureFeature: CONTINIOUS_EXPOSURE (0x00), SINGLE_SHOT_EXPOSURE (0x01).
Manual exposure range: 100 to 1000000 microseconds.
struct1:
enum class ExposureMode : uint8_t { AUTO_EXPOSURE = 0x00, MANUAL_EXPOSURE = 0x01 };
enum class AutoExposureFeature : uint8_t { CONTINIOUS_EXPOSURE = 0x00, SINGLE_SHOT_EXPOSURE = 0x01 };
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current exposure mode, auto-exposure feature, and manual exposure value.
getAPICode:
uint8_t outMode, outAutoFeature; uint32_t outManual;
see3cam_cu200Instance->getExposure(outMode, outAutoFeature, outManual);
setAPIHeading: bool setExposure(ExposureMode mode, AutoExposureFeature autoFeature, uint32_t manualExposure)
setAPIDes: Sets the exposure mode and, depending on mode, the auto-exposure feature or the manual exposure value (microseconds, 100-1000000).

tooltip: Exposure Compensation - biases the auto-exposure result brighter or darker
content1: Biases the camera's exposure result brighter or darker, specified in microseconds.
content2:
1. getExposureCompensation retrieves the current exposure compensation value.
2. setExposureCompensation sets the exposure compensation value (microseconds).
struct1:
bool getExposureCompensation(uint32_t &outValue);
bool setExposureCompensation(uint32_t value);
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current exposure compensation value.
getAPICode:
uint32_t outValue;
see3cam_cu200Instance->getExposureCompensation(outValue);
setAPIDes: Sets the exposure compensation value in microseconds.

tooltip: Auto Exposure - selects Continuous or Single-shot auto-exposure and triggers a single-shot run
content1: Selects how auto-exposure runs when Exposure is set to Auto. Continuous re-evaluates auto-exposure on every frame. Single-shot runs auto-exposure once and then holds the result; press Trigger to run a new single-shot auto-exposure. These controls are only enabled when Exposure is Auto.
content2:
AutoExposureFeatureCU200: CONTINUOUS (0x00), SINGLE_SHOT (0x01).
The auto-exposure feature is sent together with the exposure mode (ExposureModeCU200::AUTO) and the current manual exposure value in a single setExposure call (HID command SET_EXPOSURE_CU200, 0x14). The manual exposure value must still be within 100-1000000 microseconds, otherwise the call returns false.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current exposure mode, auto-exposure feature (outExposure.autoFeature) and manual exposure value.
getAPICode:
ExposureInfoCU200 outExposure;
see3cam_cu200Instance->getExposure(outExposure);
setAPIHeading: bool setExposure(ExposureModeCU200 mode, AutoExposureFeatureCU200 autoFeature, uint32_t manualExposure)
setAPIDes: Sets Auto exposure with the Continuous or Single-shot feature. Calling it again with SINGLE_SHOT triggers a new single-shot auto-exposure run.

tooltip: Manual Exposure - sets a fixed exposure time in microseconds
content1: Sets a fixed exposure time in microseconds when Exposure is set to Manual. Range is 100 to 1000000 microseconds, step 100. This control is only enabled when Exposure is Manual.
content2:
ExposureModeCU200: AUTO (0x00), MANUAL (0x01).
The manual exposure value is sent together with the exposure mode and the auto-exposure feature in a single setExposure call (HID command SET_EXPOSURE_CU200, 0x14). Values outside EXPOSURE_MIN_CU200 (100) to EXPOSURE_MAX_CU200 (1000000) are rejected.
struct1:
enum class ExposureModeCU200 : uint8_t { AUTO = 0x00, MANUAL = 0x01 };
struct ExposureInfoCU200 { uint8_t mode; uint8_t autoFeature; uint32_t manualExposure; };
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current exposure mode, auto-exposure feature and manual exposure value (outExposure.manualExposure, microseconds).
getAPICode:
ExposureInfoCU200 outExposure;
see3cam_cu200Instance->getExposure(outExposure);
setAPIHeading: bool setExposure(ExposureModeCU200 mode, AutoExposureFeatureCU200 autoFeature, uint32_t manualExposure)
setAPIDes: Sets Manual exposure with a fixed exposure time (microseconds, 100-1000000).
